module_role: Full-page sequence context for MI705, MI711, MI713, MI721 and MI723. It preserves high-value written AHU, chilled-water and heating-hot-water behavior without converting sequence prose into unprinted installed I/O, controller terminals or plan quantities.

visual_review.finding: All five full-page sequence sheets were visually reviewed. They are written sequence sources with no formal controller-terminal schedule.

sequences.finding: AHU H-O-A, occupancy, proofs/safeties, duct-static and supply-temperature reset, VAV relationships, return-air isolation, load shed, alarms and setpoints are specified for Air Ops/MTRACON.

Air Ops variable-primary CHW system uses master chiller plant sequencing, 90–95% critical-valve pressure reset, bypass minimum-flow control, seven-day lead rotation, failure staging/load shed and 45°F CHW supply setpoint.

Air Ops HHW plant enables from valve demand, stages boiler/pumps, resets differential pressure from critical valve position, uses bypass minimum flow, resets HHWS 130°F to 110°F against OA and rotates lead equipment every seven days.

Shared MTRACON/ATCT CHW plant coordinates primary/secondary loops across both buildings, stages at primary/secondary-flow relationship, resets each building's differential-pressure setpoint from critical control-valve position, and prints 25-ft/50-ft MTRACON/ATCT initial pressure setpoints.

Shared heat-recovery/boiler HHW plant operates across both buildings, requires heat-recovery control before boiler staging where available, uses 90–95% critical-valve differential-pressure control and printed MTRACON/ATCT pressure setpoints; it includes heat-recovery isolation above 140°F entering-water temperature.

source_limitations: These full-page sequence sheets establish written control behavior and some BAS integration context, but they do not provide a controller-panel terminal schedule, installed-point total or individual per-point owner/wiring mapping.

The shared MTRACON/ATCT sequences describe cross-building plant behavior; no source-derived alias is made between separate schedule/plan identities solely because a sequence references both buildings.

assertions.expected: WITH THE H-O-A SWITCH IN AUTO POSITION, THE SUPPLY FAN SHALL RUN SUBJECT TO THE SUPPLY FAN START/STOP SIGNAL (SF-SS) AND SAFETIES. FAN SPEED SHALL BE UNDER CONTROL OF THE DDC HARDWARE.

ALL SERIES FAN POWERED VAV BOXES SERVED BY THE AHU SHALL BE POLLED. IF ANY SERIES FAN POWERED BOX AIR PRIMARY AIR DAMPER IS AT 50% OPEN OR LESS, THE STATIC PRESSURE SETPOINT (SA-P-SP) SHALL BE RESET DOWNWARD SLOWLY
THE AHU SUPPLY AIR TEMPERATURE SETPOINT (SA-T-SP) SHALL BE RESET UPWARD SLOWLY

UNOCCUPIED FLOOR TEMPERATURE LOW LIMIT SETPOINT (FLR-T-LL): 65°F UNOCCUPIED FLOOR TEMPERATURE HIGH LIMIT SETPOINT (FLR-T-HL): 80°F DUCT STATIC PRESSURE SETPOINT (SA-P-SP): TBD BY TAB CONTRACTOR, INTIAL POINT: 0.8” WG SUPPLY AIR TEMPERATURE SETPOINT (SA-T-SP): 55°F

A MASTER CHILLER PLANT CONTROLLER SHALL BE PROVIDED TO ENABLE AND SEQUENCE THE CHILLERS. EACH CHILLER SHALL BE FURNISHED WITH FACTORY CONTROLS AND A BACNET COMMUNICATION BOARD TO INTEGRATE WITH THE MASTER CHILLER PLANT DDC CONTROLLER.

UPON A CALL FOR CHILLED WATER (ELEVATED CHWR TEMPERATURE), THE DDC CHILLER PLANT CONTROL PANEL SHALL OPEN THE LEAD CHILLER'S ASSOCIATED CONTROL VALVE. THE LEAD CHILLER SHOULD BE SELECTED AS THE CHILLER WITH THE LEAST RUN HOURS.

THE DIFFERENTIAL PRESSURE SETPOINT SHALL BE RESET TO KEEP THE CRITICAL CONTROL VALVE BETWEEN 90-95% OPEN. THE CRITICAL CONTROL VALVE SHALL BE THE CONTROL VALVE THAT IS THE MOST OPEN AT ANY GIVEN TIME.
THE DDC SYSTEM SHALL MODULATE THE CHW BYPASS VALVE CV-CHW-BP-A TO ENSURE CHILLER(S) MANUFACTURER MINIMUM FLOW THROUGH THE CHILLED WATER LOOP.
CHILLED WATER PRESSURE SETPOINT = 65 FT WC (INITIAL SETPOINT), CONFIRM DURING TAB

A. THIS SYSTEM SHALL MONITOR THE ENABLED STATUS OF ALL SYSTEMS SERVED BY THIS SYSTEM. IF ONE OR MORE SYSTEMS SERVED BY THIS SYSTEM ARE ENABLED (OPENING OF DOAH, VAV, AHU, CUH, UH, OR FCU HHW VALVES), THIS SYSTEM SHALL BE ENABLED (SYS-ENA).
WHEN THE HEATING PLANT IS ENABLED; ENERGIZE THE LEAD PRIMARY HHW PUMP. PROVE PRIMARY HHW PUMP STATUS AND THEN COMMAND THE LEAD SECONDARY HHW PUMP WITH LEAST RUN HOURS TO START.

THE SECONDARY HHW PUMP SPEED SHALL BE CONTROLLED TO MAINTAIN BUILDING LOOP DIFFERENTIAL SETPOINT. THE DIFFERENTIAL PRESSURE SETPOINT SHALL BE RESET TO KEEP THE CRITICAL CONTROL VALVE BETWEEN 90-95% OPEN.
THE HHWS TEMPERATURE SHALL BE RESET DOWNWARDS LINEARLY FROM 130°F WHEN THE OA DRY BLUB TEMPERATURE IS 50°F TO 110°F WHEN THE OA DRY BLUB TEMPERATURE IS 75°F.

UPON DEMAND FOR CHILLED WATER AS INDICATED ON OPENING OF CHW CONTROL VALVE (AHU, DOAH, FCU - IN EITHER MTRACON OR ATCT), THE CHILLER PLANT CONTROLLER SHALL ENABLE THE CHILLER CONTROL AND CHILLED WATER TEMPERATURE CONTROL LOOPS.

UPON A CALL FOR CHILLED WATER, THE DDC CHILLER PLANT CONTROL PANEL SHALL ENABLE THE LEAD CHILLER’S PRIMARY PUMP VIA THE LEAD CHILLER’S CONTROL PANEL. THE LEAD CHILLER SHOULD BE SELECTED AS THE CHILLER WITH THE LEAST RUN HOURS.

THE SECONDARY CHW PUMP VFD SPEED SHALL BE CONTROLLED TO MAINTAIN BUILDING LOOP DIFFERENTIAL SETPOINTS. THE DIFFERENTIAL PRESSURE SETPOINT SHALL BE RESET TO KEEP THE CRITICAL CONTROL VALVE BETWEEN 90-95% OPEN.
MTRACON CHILLED WATER PRESSURE SETPOINT = 25 FT (INITIAL SETPOINT), CONFIRM DURING TAB ATCT CHILLED WATER PRESSURE SETPOINT = 50 FT (INITIAL SETPOINT), CONFIRM DURING TAB
DEMAND FOR HHW (OPENING OF ANY HHW AHU, DOAH, FCU, CUH CONTROL VALVES IN EITHER BUILDING), THIS SYSTEM SHALL BE ENABLED (SYS-ENA). EACH BUILDING'S SECONDARY PUMP CONTROL LOOPS SHALL BE ENABLED
WHEN THE HEATING PLANT IS ENABLED AND CHILLER HEAT RECOVERY IS AVAILABLE; ENERGIZE THE LEAD HEAT RECOVERY PUMP AND SIGNAL TO LEAD CHILLER TO ENABLE CONDENSER HEAT RECOVERY.

THE SECONDARY HHW PUMP SPEED SHALL BE CONTROLLED TO MAINTAIN BUILDING LOOP DIFFERENTIAL SETPOINT. THE DIFFERENTIAL PRESSURE SETPOINT SHALL BE RESET TO KEEP THE CRITICAL CONTROL VALVE BETWEEN 90-95% OPEN.

IF THE HRHWR TEMPERATURE ABOVE 140°F (OR TEMPERATURE REQUIRED BY HEAT RECOVERY CHILLER MANUFACTURER), DISABLE THE HEAT RECOVERY PUMPS AND CLOSE CV-CH-H-MT1 AND CV-CH-H-MT2 TO ISOLATE THE HEAT RECOVERY CHILLERS FROM THE HEATING HOT WATER SYSTEM.
MTRACON HEATING HOT WATER PRESSURE SETPOINT = 20 FT WG (CONFIRM DURING TAB) ATCT HEATING HOT WATER PRESSURE SETPOINT = 30 FT WG (CONFIRM DURING TAB)
